steps.sql: SELECT STUFF('abcdef', 2, 3, 'XY') AS c0, STUFF(N'abcdef', 2, 3, 'XY') AS c1, STUFF('abcdef', 2, 3, N'XY') AS c2
SELECT STUFF('abcdef', 0, 1, 'X') AS c0, STUFF('abcdef', 7, 1, 'X') AS c1, STUFF('abcdef', 6, 10, 'X') AS c2, STUFF('abcdef', 1, 0, 'X') AS c3
SELECT STUFF('abcdef', 2, -1, 'X') AS c0, STUFF('abcdef', -1, 1, 'X') AS c1, STUFF('abcdef', 2, 1, NULL) AS c2, STUFF(NULL, 1, 1, 'x') AS c3
SELECT STUFF('abcdef', 2, 2, '') AS c0, STUFF(CAST('abc' AS char(10)), 2, 1, 'Z') AS c1, STUFF(CAST('abc' AS varchar(max)), 2, 1, 'Z') AS c2
SELECT STUFF(12345, 2, 1, 'x') AS c0, STUFF('abc', 1, 1, 9) AS c1
SELECT STUFF('abc', '2', 1, 'x') AS c0
SELECT STUFF('abc', 2.7, 1, 'x') AS c0
SELECT STUFF('abc', 1, NULL, 'x') AS c0
SELECT STUFF(0x010203, 2, 1, 0xFF) AS c0
DECLARE @s varchar(10) = 'hello'; SELECT STUFF(@s, 1, 1, 'J') AS c0, STUFF(@s, 1, 1, REPLICATE('x', 20)) AS c1
SELECT PATINDEX('%b%', 'abc') AS c0, PATINDEX('b%', 'abc') AS c1, PATINDEX('%[0-9]%', 'ab12') AS c2, PATINDEX('%z%', 'abc') AS c3
SELECT PATINDEX('%B%', 'abc') AS c0, PATINDEX(N'%c', N'abc') AS c1, PATINDEX('abc', 'abc') AS c2, PATINDEX('%', '') AS c3
SELECT PATINDEX(NULL, 'abc') AS c0
SELECT PATINDEX('%a%', NULL) AS c0
SELECT PATINDEX('%a%', CAST('xa' AS varchar(max))) AS c0, PATINDEX('%a%', CAST(NULL AS varchar(10))) AS c1
SELECT PATINDEX('%[^a-c]%', 'abcd') AS c0, PATINDEX('%_c%', 'abc') AS c1, PATINDEX('%a %', 'a ') AS c2
SELECT PATINDEX('%2%', 123) AS c0
SELECT CONCAT_WS(',', 'a', 'b', 'c') AS c0, CONCAT_WS(',', 'a', NULL, 'c') AS c1, CONCAT_WS(N'-', 'a', 1, 2.5) AS c2
SELECT CONCAT_WS(NULL, 'a', 'b') AS c0, CONCAT_WS(',', NULL, NULL) AS c1, CONCAT_WS('', 'a', 'b') AS c2
SELECT CONCAT_WS(',', CAST('a' AS varchar(10)), CAST('b' AS varchar(20))) AS c0, CONCAT_WS(', ', CAST('a' AS nvarchar(10)), 'b') AS c1
SELECT CONCAT_WS(',', CAST('a' AS varchar(max)), 'b') AS c0, CONCAT_WS(',', CAST('2024-01-02' AS date), 5) AS c1
SELECT CONCAT_WS(',', 'a') AS c0
SELECT CONCAT_WS(',', CAST('a' AS char(3)), 'b') AS c0, CONCAT_WS(',', '', 'b', '') AS c1
SELECT STR(123.456) AS c0, STR(123.456, 8, 2) AS c1, STR(-1.5, 5, 1) AS c2, STR(0.5) AS c3
SELECT STR(NULL) AS c0, STR(1, NULL) AS c1, STR(2.5, 1) AS c2, STR(-2.5, 2) AS c3
SELECT STR(1e30) AS c0, STR(1e30, 40) AS c1, STR(CAST(1 AS float)/3, 18, 16) AS c2
SELECT STR('12.5', 6, 1) AS c0
SELECT STR(12, 0) AS c0
SELECT STR(12, 9000) AS c0
SELECT STR(CAST(123.456 AS decimal(10,3)), 10, 2) AS c0, STR(CAST(5 AS money), 6, 2) AS c1, STR(5, 6, 2) AS c2
SELECT QUOTENAME('abc') AS c0, QUOTENAME('a]b') AS c1, QUOTENAME('abc', '''') AS c2, QUOTENAME('abc', '"') AS c3
SELECT QUOTENAME('abc', '(') AS c0, QUOTENAME('abc', ')') AS c1, QUOTENAME('abc', '<') AS c2, QUOTENAME('abc', '{') AS c3, QUOTENAME('abc', '>') AS c4
SELECT QUOTENAME('abc', '`') AS c0, QUOTENAME('abc', 'x') AS c1, QUOTENAME(NULL) AS c2, QUOTENAME('a', NULL) AS c3
SELECT QUOTENAME(N'a''b', '''') AS c0, QUOTENAME(N'a"b', '"') AS c1, QUOTENAME('a)b', '(') AS c2, QUOTENAME('a}b', '{') AS c3
SELECT QUOTENAME(REPLICATE('x', 128)) AS c0, QUOTENAME(REPLICATE('x', 129)) AS c1
SELECT QUOTENAME(CAST('x' AS varchar(max))) AS c0, QUOTENAME('ab', '[]') AS c1
SELECT QUOTENAME(123) AS c0
SELECT STRING_ESCAPE('a"b\c/d', 'json') AS c0, STRING_ESCAPE(N'tab' + CHAR(9) + 'nl' + CHAR(10), 'json') AS c1, STRING_ESCAPE(CHAR(1) + CHAR(31) + CHAR(127), 'json') AS c2
SELECT STRING_ESCAPE(NULL, 'json') AS c0, STRING_ESCAPE(CAST('x' AS varchar(10)), 'json') AS c1, STRING_ESCAPE(CAST('x' AS varchar(max)), 'json') AS c2
SELECT STRING_ESCAPE('x', 'html') AS c0
SELECT STRING_ESCAPE(5, 'json') AS c0
SELECT TRANSLATE('2*[3+4]/{7-2}', '[]{}', '()()') AS c0, TRANSLATE(N'abc', 'abc', 'xyz') AS c1, TRANSLATE('abcabc', 'ab', 'ba') AS c2
SELECT TRANSLATE('abc', 'ab', 'x') AS c0
SELECT TRANSLATE(NULL, 'a', 'b') AS c0, TRANSLATE('abc', NULL, 'b') AS c1, TRANSLATE('ABC', 'abc', 'xyz') AS c2
SELECT TRANSLATE(CAST('abc' AS varchar(max)), 'a', 'z') AS c0, TRANSLATE(CAST('abc' AS char(5)), 'a', 'z') AS c1
SELECT FORMAT(1234.5678, 'N2') AS c0, FORMAT(1234.5678, 'N') AS c1, FORMAT(1234, 'N0') AS c2, FORMAT(-1234.5, 'N1') AS c3
SELECT FORMAT(0.1234, 'P') AS c0, FORMAT(0.1234, 'P1') AS c1, FORMAT(1234.5, 'C') AS c2, FORMAT(1234.5, 'F3') AS c3
SELECT FORMAT(255, 'X') AS c0, FORMAT(255, 'x4') AS c1, FORMAT(42, 'D5') AS c2, FORMAT(-42, 'D') AS c3
SELECT FORMAT(1234.5678, 'E2') AS c0, FORMAT(1234.5678, 'G') AS c1, FORMAT(CAST(1234.5 AS decimal(10,2)), 'N2') AS c2, FORMAT(CAST(1234.5 AS money), 'C') AS c3

SELECT FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:30.123' AS datetime2), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS c0, FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:30.123' AS datetime2), 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss') AS c1, FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:30' AS datetime), 'yyyyMMdd') AS c2

SELECT FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:30.123' AS datetime2), 'd') AS c0, FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:30.123' AS datetime2), 'D') AS c1, FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31' AS date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy') AS c2, FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31' AS date), 'ddd MMM') AS c3

SELECT FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:30.123' AS datetime2), 'hh:mm tt') AS c0, FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:30.1234567' AS datetime2), 'HH:mm:ss.fff') AS c1, FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31 03:05:09' AS datetime2), 'H:m:s') AS c2
SELECT FORMAT(1234.5, 'N2', 'de-DE') AS c0, FORMAT(1234.5, 'N2', 'en-US') AS c1, FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31' AS date), 'd', 'en-GB') AS c2
SELECT FORMAT(NULL, 'N2') AS c0
SELECT FORMAT(1, NULL) AS c0
SELECT FORMAT(1, 'N2', 'xx-XX') AS c0
SELECT FORMAT('abc', 'N2') AS c0
SELECT FORMAT(5, 'Z') AS c0
SELECT FORMAT(CAST('13:45:30' AS time), 'hh\:mm') AS c0
SELECT SOUNDEX('Robert') AS c0, SOUNDEX('Rupert') AS c1, SOUNDEX('Tymczak') AS c2, SOUNDEX('Pfister') AS c3, SOUNDEX('Ashcraft') AS c4
SELECT SOUNDEX('') AS c0, SOUNDEX(NULL) AS c1, SOUNDEX('a') AS c2, SOUNDEX('123') AS c3, SOUNDEX(N'Lee') AS c4
SELECT SOUNDEX('Honeyman') AS c0, SOUNDEX('Smith') AS c1, SOUNDEX('Smythe') AS c2, SOUNDEX(' abc') AS c3, SOUNDEX('Gutierrez') AS c4
SELECT DIFFERENCE('Green', 'Greene') AS c0, DIFFERENCE('Robert', 'Rupert') AS c1, DIFFERENCE('abc', 'xyz') AS c2, DIFFERENCE(NULL, 'a') AS c3
SELECT UNICODE(N'') AS c0, UNICODE(NULL) AS c1, UNICODE('A') AS c2, UNICODE(N'€') AS c3, UNICODE('€') AS c4
SELECT NCHAR(0) AS c0, NCHAR(65535) AS c1, NCHAR(65536) AS c2, NCHAR(-1) AS c3, NCHAR(55357) AS c4
SELECT NCHAR(128512) AS c0
SELECT NCHAR('65') AS c0, NCHAR(65.9) AS c1
SELECT CHAR(0) AS c0, CHAR(128) AS c1, CHAR(255) AS c2, CHAR(256) AS c3, CHAR(-1) AS c4
SELECT ASCII('') AS c0, ASCII(NULL) AS c1, ASCII('€') AS c2, ASCII(N'€') AS c3, ASCII(N'雪') AS c4, ASCII(65) AS c5
SELECT LEFT('abcdef', 3) AS c0, RIGHT(N'abcdef', 3) AS c1, LEFT(CAST('abc' AS varchar(max)), 2) AS c2
SELECT SUBSTRING('abcdef', 2, 3) AS c0, SUBSTRING(N'abcdef', 2, 3) AS c1, SUBSTRING('abcdef', 0, 3) AS c2, SUBSTRING('abcdef', -5, 10) AS c3
SELECT SUBSTRING('abcdef', 10, 3) AS c0, SUBSTRING(CAST('abc' AS char(10)), 2, 5) AS c1, SUBSTRING(CAST('abc' AS varchar(max)), 2, 1) AS c2, SUBSTRING(0x01020304, 2, 2) AS c3
SELECT SUBSTRING('abcdef', 2, NULL) AS c0
SELECT SUBSTRING(NULL, 1, 2) AS c0
SELECT SUBSTRING('abc', 1, -1) AS c0
SELECT SUBSTRING(123456, 2, 3) AS c0
DECLARE @s nvarchar(20) = N'abcdef', @i int = 2; SELECT SUBSTRING(@s, @i, 3) AS c0, SUBSTRING(@s, 2, @i) AS c1, LEFT(@s, @i) AS c2
SELECT REPLACE('abcabc', 'b', 'XX') AS c0, REPLACE(N'abc', 'b', 'X') AS c1, REPLACE('abc', N'b', 'X') AS c2, REPLACE('abc', 'b', '') AS c3
SELECT REPLACE('aBc', 'b', 'X') AS c0, REPLACE('abc' COLLATE Latin1_General_CS_AS, 'B', 'X') AS c1, REPLACE('abc', '', 'X') AS c2, REPLACE(NULL, 'a', 'b') AS c3
SELECT REPLACE(CAST('abc' AS varchar(10)), 'b', 'XYZ') AS c0, REPLACE(CAST('abc' AS varchar(max)), 'b', 'X') AS c1, REPLACE(CAST('abc ' AS char(5)), ' ', '_') AS c2
SELECT REPLACE(12345, 3, 'x') AS c0
SELECT CHARINDEX('b', 'abc') AS c0, CHARINDEX('B', 'abc') AS c1, CHARINDEX('c', 'abcabc', 4) AS c2, CHARINDEX('c', 'abcabc', -5) AS c3, CHARINDEX('', 'abc') AS c4
SELECT CHARINDEX('b', CAST('abc' AS varchar(max))) AS c0, CHARINDEX(NULL, 'abc') AS c1, CHARINDEX('a', 'abc', NULL) AS c2, CHARINDEX(N'b', 'abc') AS c3
SELECT CHARINDEX('a', 'abc', 10) AS c0, CHARINDEX('b' COLLATE Latin1_General_CS_AS, 'aBc') AS c1
SELECT LEN('abc  ') AS c0, LEN(N'  abc') AS c1, LEN('') AS c2, LEN(CAST('x' AS varchar(max))) AS c3, LEN(12.50) AS c4
SELECT DATALENGTH('abc  ') AS c0, DATALENGTH(N'ab') AS c1, DATALENGTH(CAST(1 AS bigint)) AS c2, DATALENGTH(CAST('x' AS nvarchar(max))) AS c3, DATALENGTH(NULL) AS c4

SELECT DATALENGTH(CAST(1.5 AS decimal(5,1))) AS c0, DATALENGTH(CAST(1.5 AS decimal(20,1))) AS c1, DATALENGTH(CAST('2024-01-01' AS datetime2)) AS c2, DATALENGTH(CAST('10:00' AS time(2))) AS c3, DATALENGTH(CAST(1 AS real)) AS c4
SELECT UPPER('abc') AS c0, LOWER(N'ÀBC') AS c1, UPPER(CAST('x' AS char(3))) AS c2, UPPER(12) AS c3, LOWER(NULL) AS c4
SELECT REVERSE('abc') AS c0, REVERSE(N'a🦆b') AS c1, REVERSE(123) AS c2, REVERSE(CAST('ab' AS char(4))) AS c3
SELECT LTRIM('  a  ') AS c0, RTRIM(N'  a  ') AS c1, TRIM('  a  ') AS c2, LTRIM(12) AS c3, TRIM(CAST(' a' AS char(4))) AS c4
SELECT LTRIM('xxaxx', 'x') AS c0, RTRIM('xxaxx', 'x') AS c1, TRIM('x' FROM 'xxaxx') AS c2, TRIM(NULL) AS c3
SELECT SPACE(5) AS c0, REPLICATE('ab', 2) AS c1, REPLICATE(N'ab', 2) AS c2, CONCAT('a', 1, NULL) AS c3
SELECT CONCAT(CAST('a' AS varchar(10)), CAST('b' AS nvarchar(5))) AS c0, CONCAT('a', CAST(1 AS int), CAST(2 AS bigint)) AS c1, CONCAT(1.5, CAST('2024-01-01' AS date)) AS c2
SELECT CONCAT(NULL, NULL) AS c0, CONCAT(CAST('a' AS varchar(max)), 'b') AS c1, CONCAT(0x41, 'b') AS c2
SELECT STRING_AGG('a', ',') AS c0
